identity.title: Identity
identity.readOnlyNote: Passport and company details can only be changed by the account holder — to correct one, reject the submission with a reason so they can edit and re-submit. A misspelled legal name is the exception: it needs no rejection, and can be corrected while the account holder is locked out of editing.
identity.incomplete: Identity is incomplete. All four passport fields must be filled before they can submit for review — approving files won't unblock it.

documents.title: Submitted documents
documents.silentNote: A decision on a single file is silent: it changes nothing about the account and notifies nobody. The decision below is what reaches them.

docReject.placeholder: What is wrong with this file?

decision.title: Decision
decision.rejectPlaceholder: Tell them what to fix before re-submitting.
decision.waitingForSubmission: They haven't submitted these documents for review yet. Approving files here doesn't change that — the decision opens once they submit.
decision.rejectedWaiting: Rejected. Waiting for them to fix what you flagged and submit again.
decision.alreadyDecided: This submission has already been decided.

contract.title: Contract
contract.sendNote: Sending renders the contract and asks them to sign. You can recall it while it is unsigned.
contract.lockedNote: Approve the documents first — a contract can only be written for an approved account.
contract.awaitingNote: Sent, waiting for their signature. Recall it if the terms need to change.
contract.pdfMissing: This document isn't available. That's a problem on the server, not something you can retry.
contract.renewNote: Renewing writes a new contract that takes over when this one ends.
contract.notSubmittedNote: They haven't submitted their documents for review yet, so there is nothing to approve and no contract to write.
contract.rejectedNote: You rejected this submission. A contract can be written once they re-submit and you approve it.
contract.terminateBody: Cover ends now instead of on {date}. The contract is kept and marked as ended early — it is not deleted, and this is recorded in the audit log. The subject loses access to anything that requires active cover.
contract.withdrawBody: The contract is retired without ever taking effect. Use this for a contract that should not have been authored; to correct one that was sent, recall it instead and edit the draft.
contract.cancelUpcomingBody: This contract was due to start on {date} and will not take effect. It is kept and marked as ended early — not deleted — and this is recorded in the audit log. The subject's current access is unaffected.

detail.requiredBodyCompany: An identity document plus a company registration. A business licence does not stand in for the registration.
detail.requiredBodyPerson: An identity document. This owner is a natural person, so no company file is required.
detail.viewerNoneBody: This owner has not uploaded any documents, so there is nothing to check and nothing to decide.

detail.fileVerdictSilent: Silent — it moves no status and notifies nobody.

kyc.title: Not submitted yet

review.title: Decision open

rejected.title: The ball is with the owner
rejected.body: Rejected. Waiting for them to fix what you flagged and submit again.

decided.title: Already decided
decided.body: This submission has been answered. Per-file verdicts stay available, and the contract takes it from here.

detail.decisionOnlyThis: This is the only thing that reaches the owner. Approving every file above does not approve the account.

detail.decisionForbidden: Your role can read this submission but not decide it.
detail.rejectSubmissionBody: The owner is notified with your reason and can edit and re-submit. Existing per-file verdicts stay as they are.
detail.rejectSubmissionPlaceholder: Tell them what to fix before re-submitting.
detail.readOnlyNote: Only the account holder can change these — to fix a wrong passport number, reject with a reason.
detail.historyEmpty: Nothing has been decided on this bundle yet.
detail.historyScopeNote: Verdicts and their times only. Who made each decision is not returned by any endpoint yet, so no name is shown rather than a guessed one.
detail.lockedUntilApproved: Contract authoring stays locked until this bundle is approved — the server answers 409 onboarding_not_approved.
detail.forbiddenBody: Reading an owner's documents needs the kyc:review permission, which your role does not include.
detail.stillOpenableBody: Files stay readable after approval. Re-deciding one changes nothing about the account or the contract.
